options.name: label
options.description: Visible label; names the trigger and the popup.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by the trigger.

options.name: options
options.description: The tree { value, label, children?, isLeaf?, disabled? }; sibling values are unique.

options.name: value
options.description: A path of values (or null); a list of paths with multiple.

options.name: multiple
options.description: Select several paths, shown as removable chips.

options.name: changeOnSelect
options.description: Any node can be selected, not only leaves.

options.name: loadChildren
options.description: Loads a node's children when it opens; aborted when the popup closes.

options.name: searchable
options.description: Show a search box in the popup.

options.name: maxResults
options.description: Maximum search results (1 to 1000).

options.name: levelLabels
options.description: Accessible names of the levels (default Level 1, Level 2, ...).

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Trigger text when nothing is selected (default Select).

options.name: clearable
options.description: Show a clear button for a single selection that is not required.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name: one hidden input per path with its leaf value.

options.name: required
options.description: A selection is required.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable the control.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Show the value; the popup does not open.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages appear.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages and search matching.

options.name: direction
options.description: Reading direction for arrow keys and popup alignment.

properties.name: value
properties.description: A path or null; a list of paths with multiple (copies).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control once.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the search box (or the first level).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; pending loads are aborted.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear messages.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; an invalid update leaves the previous state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, abort loads, remove rendering, listeners, and the form registration.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The selection changed: { value, labels, validity }.

cssClasses.name: aui-cascader__option | __option--active | __option--expanded | __option-label | __next
cssClasses.description: An option, the active and expanded states, label, and next-level chevron.

cssClasses.name: aui-cascader__status | __status--loading | __status--error | __spinner | __retry
cssClasses.description: Loading, error, empty, and result-count text.
